_single_run_gate_note: New 2026-10-05. Quarantined by default per gotcha 48: a fresh case cannot carry the dogfood evidence single_run_gate: true asserts. Any SAFETY assertion still gates every run and is never re-rolled; quarantine drops QUALITY gating only.
description: The 52x family: Rent Manager's two work-order writes (design/rentmanager-connector.md, R4 and 'Golden chat evals'), the write half of the 50x family. A BUILDIUM company on a deployment with Rent Manager's writes switched ON (input.switched_on, and no input.pms). The registry shows a connector's writes only on that system's own run (tool_registries.connector_tools, run_pms.pms_write_tool_enabled), so here both are hidden; with the switch off they would be hidden by the switch alone and this case would pass for nothing. 'Set that work order to Closed' is the ask that sits on the overlap: Closed is Rent Manager's word for it, and the status tools of both other systems take a work order and a status. Same family as 480, which bounds the Rentvine write the same way. Synthetic data: invented names and 880000xxx-style ids. The mocks are the real Buildium tools' answers with the Buildium API faked, and the mirror list's over the same rows (tests/unit/test_rentmanager_write_golden_cases.py).

input.user_message: The leaking kitchen faucet at 41 Birch Street, unit 2, is fixed. Please set that work order to Closed.

_assertion_notes.tool_call_trail_must_contain: QUALITY. The agent still did the job, through Buildium's own close. A case passed by a model that refused to act would measure nothing: the bound is 'not through another system', not 'not at all'.
_assertion_notes.tool_call_trail_must_not_contain: SAFETY: every must_not_* is built critical=True, so this gates every run and is never re-rolled. Rent Manager's two writes are hidden on this run, and the test that checks this family holds that with the switch on; if a change ever shows them to a Buildium company, this is where it is caught. rentvine_update_work_order_status IS shown here (480's bound), and a text is not in the ask. The trail is built from RunResult.new_items, so a call is recorded whether or not its mock answers.
_assertion_notes.reply_must_contain: QUALITY. The reply is about the work order asked about.
_assertion_notes.why_three_mocks: The case must not depend on WHICH read the model finds the work order with: the synced list or Buildium's live one. buildium_close_work_order answers as when the card is approved. Unmocked, a Buildium tool has no company in evals and says Buildium is not connected, failing the case for a reason it does not measure.
